plan:
new project acme with the gitflow methodology at TMP/acme
  git repository with the branches: master develop (the first is the initial one; work starts on the last)
  files:
    README.md
    VERSION
    CHANGELOG.md
    CONTRIBUTING.md
    AGENTS.md
    Makefile
    CLAUDE.md
    .gitignore
    .github/workflows/test.yml
  no --url: the answers are stored later, when the remote exists: qargi project attach TMP/acme --url URL
  deployment: not chosen (see below)
  provider: not chosen (none is stored; set one with qargi project set acme models.provider NAME, or models.provider.local / models.provider.cloud)

Deployment differs a lot between projects, so nothing is set up unless you choose it. Each option can be done for you or by hand.

none             Nothing yet
github-release   A GitHub release with the built files  (can be done for you)
container-image  A container image built by CI on a tag  (can be done for you)
package-registry A package published to a registry on a tag  (can be done for you)

choose one with --deployment ID (qargi methodology deployment gitflow ID shows how); you can do it by hand or ask for it to be done for you
apply: qargi project new acme --dir TMP/acme --param year=2026 --plan TOKEN --approved "<the user's go-ahead>"
